look.description: A tan, too-white grin in a sponsor-patched leather jacket, a phone on a chest mount and a ring light zip-tied to the bars. Rides a glossy sport bike covered in stickers.

meta.notes: Regular. M4 rivals-1 (built early): a showboat. He fights only when it will look good: never the race leader (he sides with whoever is winning, which makes him the natural gang-up partner), and never anyone healthier than him. Rivalries: Dial-Up and Deacon Vane. Prefers a selfie stick (a weapons-2 idea; nothing yet). Tied to the streaming outfit. Approved line: "Smash that subscri— oh. You're smashed."
